name: Step 3 — Upload PSP Reconciliation File to SwiftCent
description: Step 3 of the AWS PG Webhook workflow: uploads the PSP reconciliation CSV built in Step 2 to the SwiftCent SFTP landing folder — the same folder the Konza workflow uploads to, so the reconciliation engine sees transactions from both environments. No downstream UI/settlement/payout verification in this suite.
